Name: Official Xbox Magazine: Volume 84: June 2008
Overview:
Official Xbox Magazine (OXM) Demo Disc #84 shipped to subscribers in May 2008 (bearing the cover date of June 2008 for Issue 84). Formatted natively for Xbox 360 hardware, Disc #84 brought an action-packed summer preview lineup featuring high-definition 360 playable game demos, Xbox Live Arcade (XLA) trials, custom gamerpics, and exclusive video content:

Iron Man (third-person superhero action)
UEFA EURO 2008 (soccer simulation)
Dragon Ball Z: Burst Limit (anime fighting game)
Ikaruga (Xbox Live Arcade vertical bullet-hell shoot 'em up)
Braid (Xbox Live Arcade time-manipulation puzzle-platformer)
Rocky and Bullwinkle (Xbox Live Arcade party minigame collection)

In addition to interactive gameplay, the native 360 disc delivered custom downloadable dashboard themes and gamerpics, offline backward-compatibility emulation updates, and high-definition 720p/1080i video previews—including featurettes for Gears of War 2, Grand Theft Auto IV, Star Wars: The Force Unleashed, and Prince of Persia, alongside OXM's monthly Top Plays segment.
